title: Independent Issues isolate multi-repository candidates and accept explicitly
description: Verify external persistent worktrees, lazy nested repository preparation, native subprocess write restrictions, revision-bound acceptance, idempotent Run replay and process-wide dispatch capacity.
preconditions: Git and workspace dependencies are installed. Linux requires bubblewrap and permitted user/PID/mount namespaces; macOS uses sandbox-exec.

steps.target: worker execution tests and Go acceptance/replay/dispatch race tests

assertions.target: Source remains unchanged until Accept, revision conflicts block integration, independent work dispatches in parallel and retries retain Run history.

automation.command: pnpm --filter @foundry/worker test && cd apps/server && go test -race ./internal/httpapi ./internal/sqlitestore

cleanup: Tests remove their temporary repositories and candidate stores.
